evidence.headline: DaisyRose-27B improves Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 from 5.6% to 12.0%.
evidence.idea: In this post, we explain how carefully designed tasks and efficient infrastructure made these gains possible on a limited compute budget.
bullets: Stable over weeks. The release run trained for weeks on 144 H200s, 63,000 GPU-hours in total.

On this release, 37% of each GPU's peak compute went into useful training work (model FLOPs utilization, or MFU) on our backend. The open-source trainer, built on Megatron, reached 16% on comparable runs.
Between mid-September and mid-November, the service ran about 944,000 sandboxes for this project, with up to 1,566 running at the same time.
evidence.summary: We are releasing BF16 , FP8 , and NVFP4 checkpoints for everyone to try and build on.
evidence.practice_takeaway: Each task targets a mistake the original model makes.

rewrite.headline: RadixArk's RL training more than doubles a 27B model's Terminal-Bench 4.1 score
rewrite.idea: Training on 1,200 curated long-horizon tasks lifted pass@1 from 5.6% to 12.0%.
